{{Quote|Our fleet has destroyed their orbital defenses! The day is ours! Pellaeon's personal guard is all that stands between us and the Admiral himself!|[[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Ennix Devian]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 6">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 6|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 6]]</ref>}}
The fourth '''battle''' of [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]] occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and a dissident Imperial faction of hardliners, the [[Restored Empire]], for the control of the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] Orinda and thus gain control over the Remnant.

==Background==
{{Quote|It was a brilliant scheme. Pellaeon could never have expected that another force existed.''"<br />"''Yes. It looks like that old fox has finally made a fatal mistake.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]] and Devian|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 5">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 5|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 5]]</ref>}}
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[Feena D'Asta]] represented the Imperial Remnant during negotiations with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The negotiations were [[Ambush at the peace negotiations|interruped]] when they were attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Restored Empire]] and D'Asta was killed during the ambush. Shocked by the death of Feena D'Asta and suspecting a New Republic betrayal, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] ordered the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to attack the Republic in retaliation, letting the Imperial capital [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]] insufficiently defended. [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Ennix Devian]] planned to attack the planet in order to kill Pellaeon and claim the title of [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Empire]].

Meanwhile, [[Kir Kanos]] was reintroduced to [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]] and [[Feena D'Asta (clone)|Feena D'Asta's clone]]. The baron's plan was to position his [[D'Asta private fleet|fleet]] behind the moons of Orinda in wait for the imminent hardliner strike, and to convince Devian that Feena survived the assassination "attempt" by bringing him face-to-face with her clone.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Pellaeon dies !|Vota|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 6" />}}
[[File:Pellaeon_captured.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] surrenders.]]
The Restored Empire fleet entered the [[Orinda system/Legends|Orinda system]] and attacked the planet. This ancient but massive fleet was able to destroy the small defense fleet and Devian's ground forces landed on the planet. Devian and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] entered the Imperial headquarters and eliminated most resistance. [[Zam Basdor]] revealed his treachery but he was personally shot in the head by Admiral Pellaeon. Pellaeon and his last troopers were surrending when Kanos, [[Mirith Sinn]], Feena's clone, her "father" arrived in the base.

After the reveal of the Feena clone to Devian and the mobilization of the dormant D'Astan fleet hidden in the system, a massive firefight erupted, killing [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]] and most of Devian's stormtroopers.
[[File:Kanos_kills_Devian.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Kir Kanos]] kills [[Ennix Devian|Devian]].]]
Kanos pursued Devian to his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], where he announced his intent to destroy the hardliner cause once and for all. Although Kanos managed to sever the warlord's weapon in the ensuing duel, Devian eventually gained the upper hand, bisecting Kanos's weapon and piercing him in the chest with his vibro-blade. Critically injured, Kanos used whatever strength he had left to overpower Devian and skewer him vertically through the left shoulder, putting an end to the hardliner plot.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|What do you think the future has in store for him?''"<br />"''Who can tell? But I am certain that Kir Kanos is dead. A new life gained... but an Empire lost.|Feena D'asta's clone and Ragez D'Asta after Kanos' departure|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 6" />}}
Although Kanos was critically injured by Devian's attack, he survived long enough for Mirith Sinn to transport him to one of Baron D'Asta's hidden safehouses in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]]. Believing Kanos to be dying, Sinn said her goodbyes and returned to the galactic capital, speaking before the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], to posthumously pardon Kanos of his charges against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. She was unaware that Kanos had, in fact, been nursed back to health by D'Asta and his daughter and was living with them for several months.
